stories.title: A BITS Pilani alumnus from UP quit his high-paying Microsoft job to build a Bengaluru-based AI startup, missing Rs 15 lakh voluntary exit offer by just a month; his venture joins OpenAI's partner network
stories.summary: Atishay Jain made a significant career decision by leaving Microsoft to start his own AI company. Although he missed a potential Rs 15 lakh voluntary exit payout, he does not regret his choice. His new venture, ScaleWorks AI, aims to assist businesses in adopting AI technologies.
